title: The summary strip shows seven figures and no Adjustments figure
refs: SV-9282 (WIP Story 5; WIP report design review 2026-08-13 - seven summary figures in grouped order,no Adjustments tile in the strip)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Open work orders with work-order-level fees or discounts appear on the report..
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report.
2. Read the summary strip at the top of the report.
expected:
1. The summary strip shows exactly seven figures, in this order: Completed Work on Open Work Orders, Work Orders Ready to Invoice, Total Completed Work, Work Orders Not Started, Remaining Work on Open Work Orders, Remaining Work, and Estimates.
2. There is no Adjustments figure in the summary strip.
3. Work-order-level fees and discounts are carried only by the Adjustments column and the per-tab Totals row, not by a summary figure.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, the Work In Progress report design review of 13 August 2026 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/42c35f46-2796-467e-9723-7daa5385446e), and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S5-R1; S5-R13), read on 26 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/20/2026.
The figure names above are the 13 August 2026 design-review names; they replace the earlier specification names (Total Earned, Total Remaining, Not Started, Started - Earned, Started - Remaining, Ready to Invoice), and we have taken the latest design review as prevailing.

AUTOMATION: READY
